crossRefs.note: “I think myself happy, King Agrippa, that I am to make my defense before you today concerning all the things that I am…
For the king knows of these things, to whom also I speak freely. For I am persuaded that none of these things is hidden…
King Agrippa, do you believe the prophets? I know that you believe.”
Moses said, “Oh, Lord, please send someone else.”
Yahweh’s anger burned against Moses, and he said, “What about Aaron, your brother, the Levite? I know that he can speak…
The Lord Yahweh has opened my ear. I was not rebellious. I have not turned back.
If I say, I will not make mention of him, or speak any more in his name, then there is in my heart as it were a burning…
You shall speak my words to them, whether they will hear, or whether they will refuse; for they are most rebellious.
But you, son of man, hear what I tell you. Don’t be rebellious like that rebellious house. Open your mouth, and eat…
So the Spirit lifted me up, and took me away; and I went in bitterness, in the heat of my spirit; and Yahweh’s hand was…
But Jonah rose up to flee to Tarshish from the presence of Yahweh. He went down to Joppa, and found a ship going to…
to reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the Gentiles, I didn’t immediately confer with flesh and blood,
